title: The maximum cardinality of a planar seven-distance set
summary: We give a computer-assisted proof that the maximum cardinality of a planar set determining at most seven distinct positive distances is sixteen. A diameter-graph argument reduces a hypothetical seventeen-point example to an eleven-point set with at most six distances, except for a thirteen-cycle obstruction. We exclude the cycle by an exact interval certificate. Using a published exhaustive count of sixty-two candidate distance patterns, we classify the eleven-point cores by exact Gröbner-basis calculations and prove that none can have the required seventeen- point extension.
